name: geometric excitations
domain: 车辆轨道基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 由结构几何不规则或附加变形形成的动力输入。

complete_examples.text: The deformation coordinated process of track-soil interaction is regarded as the geometric excitations to dynamic analysis, classified as three aspects: (I) contact-separation relationship of track-soil interface; (II) interlayered gap between track and soil surface; (III) additional track deformation.
Hence, the rail deformation calculated in this example is regarded as one of the geometric excitations of wheel-rail interaction in the dynamic analysis of example 2.
